steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on the buyer's Master QCS screen.
Enable the eRFX project configuration required by the case.
Verify the two expected vendor columns are present with real names.
Verify Vendor A's displayed rank before downloading the report.
Verify Vendor B's displayed rank before downloading the report.
Verify Vendor A's unit price on Master QCS.
Verify Vendor B's unit price on Master QCS.
Verify Vendor A's line amount and total arithmetic on Master QCS.
Verify Vendor B's line amount and total arithmetic on Master QCS.
Download the Master QCS comparison report.
Check the downloaded report contains both vendors and the prepared-state prices and totals.
